notes.title: Dunk Dunk Playtest Update 1!
notes.notes:
Good day, folks!

First of all, big love to anyone reading this who has already tried Dunk Dunk! 

If you haven't yet, here's 15 minutes of me challenging my boss to the last playtest!

[previewyoutube=W_QANXJENm4;full][/previewyoutube]

With that out the way, it's time for our first update to the Dunk Dunk playtest that we're running right now!

This time, we're giving you a new map "SubLab" which features more platforms and a wicked water effect to throw you off course. We're also mixing up the game with new mutators, swap out the regular ball for a saw blade that sticks into surfaces and/or turn on moon gravity to really get some height on those DUUUUUNKS

So what are you waiting for? What? A convenient link to take you to the Dunk Dunk page, placed directly at the end of this article? Easy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2410590/Dunk_Dunk/
